metadata.title: USDA DR1043-031: Advisory Committee on Animal Health

roles.title: Policy Forge — USDA OCIO DISC Digital Modernization Fellowship

parties.name: U.S. Department of Agriculture — Office of the Chief Information Officer

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: This regulation establishes the Advisory Committee on Animal Health (Committee).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
a. The duration of the Committee shall be 2 years. 


b. This regulation will expire 2 years from the date of filing.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The Committee is established by the Secretary of the Department of Agriculture in 
accordance with the Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA) as amended, 5 U.S.C. 
App.2.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The purpose is to advise the Secretary of Agriculture on means to prevent, conduct 
surveillance for, monitor, control, or eradicate animal diseases of national importance. In 
doing so, the committee will consider public health, conservation of natural resources, and 
the stability of livestock economies.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The duties of the Committee involve advising and counseling USDA on: 


a. USDA’s livestock disease management and traceability strategies. 



b. Engaging Tribal, small and minority farmers, and nontraditional livestock 
producers in safeguarding animal health. 



c. Prioritizing animal health initiatives.

groups.title: Official To Whom The Committee Reports

controls.title: Official To Whom The Committee Reports

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The Advisory Committee on Animal Health makes recommendations to the Secretary 
of Agriculture.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The National Center for Animal Health and Emergency Management will provide 
support to the Committee and to the Designated Federal Official (DFO) in the 
conduct of the official duties of the Committee.

groups.title: Estimated Annual Costs And Staff Years

controls.title: Estimated Annual Costs And Staff Years

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Estimated annual operating expenses are $60,000 and .25 FTE staff years.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The Chief Operating Officer of Veterinary Services, Animal and Plant Health 
Inspection Service shall serve as the DFO. As a full-time or permanent part-time 
employee, appointed in accordance with agency procedures, the DFO or the alternate 
DFO will approve or call all of the advisory committee’s meetings, prepare and 
approve all meeting agendas, attend all committee meetings, adjourn any meeting 
when the DFO determines adjournment to be in the public interest, and chair 
meetings when directed to do so by the official to whom the advisory committee 
reports.

groups.title: Estimated Number And Frequency Of Meetings

controls.title: Estimated Number And Frequency Of Meetings

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
The Committee will meet approximately one or more times annually as determined to 
be in the interest of USDA. All meetings will be open to the public.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
This committee will be established for 2 years from the filing date of the charter. If 
the work of the Committee is completed before that date, the committee will be 
terminated in accordance with FACA.

parts.name: statement
statement
parts.prose:
The DFO may form subcommittees for purposes consistent with this charter. Any 
subcommittee, workgroup or task force must report back to the parent committee and 
must not provide advice or work products directly to the Agency.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
Records of the Committee, formally and informally established subcommittees, or 
other subgroups of the Committee, will be handled in accordance with General 
Records Schedule 26, Item 2 or other approved USDA records directives and 
disposition schedule. These records will be available for public inspection and 
copying, subject to the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. 552 and FACA.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
This charter will be filed with the Library of Congress and Congressional oversight 
committees as required by FACA. The filing date shall be the day the charter is filed 
by the USDA Committee Management Officer upon issuance via the USDA 
Departmental Regulations. 




 

 

 

 -END-
